description.en: When the user wants to plan, design, or implement an A/B test or experiment, or build a growth experimentation program. Also use when the user mentions "A/B test," "split test," "experiment," "test this change," "variant copy," "multivariate test," "hypothesis," "should I test this," "which version is better," "test two versions," "statistical significance," "how long should I run this test," "growth experiments," "experiment velocity," "experiment backlog," "ICE score," "experimentation program," or "experiment playbook." Use this whenever someone is comparing two approaches and wants to measure which performs better, or when they want to build a systematic experimentation practice. For tracking implementation, see analytics. For page-level conversion optimization, see cro.
description.zh: 当用户想规划、设计或落地 A/B 测试或实验，或搭建增长实验体系时使用。用户提到「A/B 测试」「分流测试」「实验」「测一下这个改动」「变体文案」「多变量测试」「假设」「该不该测」「哪个版本更好」「跑多久才有结论」「统计显著性」「增长实验」「实验速度」「实验待办」「ICE 评分」「实验手册」时也适用。只要有人在比较两种方案并想要可衡量的结论，就用它。

description.en: Use when main results pass result-to-claim (claim_supported=yes or partial) and ablation studies are needed for paper submission.
description.zh: 当主要实验结果已通过 result-to-claim 检验（claim_supported 为 yes 或 partial），且论文投稿前需要补做消融实验时使用。

description.en: When the user wants to generate, iterate, or scale ad creative — headlines, descriptions, primary text, or full ad variations — for any paid advertising platform. Also use when the user mentions 'ad copy variations,' 'ad creative,' 'generate headlines,' 'RSA headlines,' 'bulk ad copy,' 'ad iterations,' 'creative testing,' 'write me some ads,' 'Facebook ad copy,' 'Google ad headlines,' 'LinkedIn ad text,' 'static ads,' 'ad templates,' 'iMessage ad,' 'chat reveal ad,' 'ChatGPT ad,' 'Apple Notes ad,' 'AirDrop ad,' 'creative strategy,' 'creative roadmap,' 'creative retro,' 'hook writing,' 'creative review page,' 'present ad creative for approval,' 'motion video ad,' 'faceless video ad,' 'UGC ad,' 'greenscreen ad,' 'TikTok/Reels ad format,' 'which ad format to make,' 'Meta ad format tier lis...
description.zh: 当用户想生成、迭代或批量产出广告创意——标题、描述、正文或整套广告变体——用于任意付费广告平台时使用。用户提到「广告文案变体」「广告创意」「生成标题」「RSA 标题」「批量广告文案」「广告迭代」「创意测试」「帮我写几条广告」「Facebook 广告文案」「Google 广告标题」「LinkedIn 广告正文」「静态广告」「广告模板」「iMessage 广告」「聊天揭示广告」「创意策略」「创意路线图」「创意复盘」「钩子写作」时也适用。

description.en: Brownfield audit — do existing artifacts actually work? Numbered migration plan. Unlike /project-stage-detect, checks compliance not existence.
description.zh: 存量项目审计——已有产物是否真的能用？输出带编号的迁移计划。与 /project-stage-detect 不同，这里查的是合规性而不是存在性。

description.en: When the user wants help with paid advertising campaigns on Google Ads, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), LinkedIn, Twitter/X, or other ad platforms. Also use when the user mentions 'PPC,' 'paid media,' 'ROAS,' 'CPA,' 'ad campaign,' 'retargeting,' 'audience targeting,' 'Google Ads,' 'Facebook ads,' 'LinkedIn ads,' 'ad budget,' 'cost per click,' 'ad spend,' 'should I run ads,' 'ABM,' 'account-based marketing,' 'B2B ads,' 'lead quality,' 'negative keywords,' 'Performance Max,' 'thought leader ads,' 'when should I kill an ad,' 'search terms report,' 'wasted spend,' or 'is this campaign working.' Use this for campaign strategy, audience targeting, bidding, and optimization. For bulk ad creative generation and iteration, see ad-creative. For landing page optimization, see cro.
description.zh: 当用户需要 Google Ads、Meta（Facebook/Instagram）、LinkedIn、Twitter/X 或其他广告平台的付费投放帮助时使用。用户提到「PPC」「付费媒体」「ROAS」「CPA」「广告活动」「再营销」「受众定向」「Google Ads」「Facebook 广告」「LinkedIn 广告」「广告预算」「单次点击成本」「广告花费」「该不该投广告」「ABM」「基于客户的营销」「B2B 广告」「线索质量」「否定关键词」「效果最大化」「意见领袖广告」「什么时候该停掉一条广告」「搜索词报告」「浪费的预算」时也适用。

description.en: Audit Amazon Ads profiles, regions, Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, DSP, portfolios, targeting, search terms, retail readiness, creative, budgets, ACOS, TACOS, reporting, and policy. Use for Amazon Ads, sponsored ads, Amazon PPC, ACOS, TACOS, ASIN advertising, Amazon DSP, or retail-media optimization.
description.zh: 审计 Amazon Ads 的账户结构、区域、商品推广、品牌推广、展示型推广、DSP、商品集、定向、搜索词、上架就绪度、创意、预算、ACOS、TACOS、报表与政策合规。适用于 Amazon Ads、赞助广告、Amazon PPC、ACOS、TACOS、ASIN 广告、Amazon DSP 或零售媒体优化。

description.en: Audit Apple Ads measurement, AdServices and AdAttributionKit, campaign and keyword structure, Search Match, App Store placements, custom product pages, bidding, budgets, MMP reconciliation, and policy. Use for Apple Ads, Apple Search Ads, App Store ads, Search Match, custom product pages, AdServices, or Apple app-install campaigns.
description.zh: 审计 Apple Ads 的衡量体系、AdServices 与 AdAttributionKit、广告系列与关键词结构、Search Match、App Store 展示位置、自定义产品页、出价、预算、MMP 对账与政策合规。适用于 Apple Ads、Apple Search Ads、App Store 广告、Search Match、自定义产品页、AdServices 或 Apple 应用安装投放。

description.en: Audit cross-platform attribution, conversion definitions, reporting windows, GA4, AdServices and AdAttributionKit, MMPs, browser and server events, offline conversions, and platform reconciliation. Use for attribution audit, attribution models, conversion windows, requests to add or total Meta and Google conversions, incompatible reporting-window aggregation, GA4 attribution, MMP review, AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch, Singular, or cross-platform discrepancies.
description.zh: 审计跨平台归因、转化定义、归因窗口、GA4、AdServices 与 AdAttributionKit、MMP、浏览器与服务器事件、离线转化以及平台间对账。适用于归因审计、归因模型、转化窗口、Meta 与 Google 转化数相加的诉求、归因窗口不兼容导致的汇总错误、GA4 归因、MMP 复核、AppsFlyer、Adjust、Branch、Singular 或跨平台数据不一致。

description.en: Quick single-paper lookup via AlphaXiv LLM-optimized summaries with tiered source fallback. Use when user says "explain this paper", "summarize paper", pastes an arXiv/AlphaXiv URL, or provides a bare arXiv ID for quick understanding - not for broad literature search.
description.zh: 用 AlphaXiv 面向 LLM 优化的摘要快速查询单篇论文，带分层的数据源回退。适用于用户说「讲讲这篇论文」「总结这篇论文」，粘贴 arXiv/AlphaXiv 链接，或只给一个 arXiv ID 想快速了解——不适用于大范围文献检索。

description.en: Analog, VHS, CRT, and found-footage horror aesthetics for Blender shots including camera imperfections and documentary framing.
description.zh: Blender 模拟恐怖与伪纪录片美学：模拟胶片、VHS、CRT 质感、相机瑕疵与纪录片式取景。

description.en: Analyze ML experiment results, compute statistics, generate comparison tables and insights. Use when user says "analyze results", "compare", or needs to interpret experimental data.
description.zh: 分析机器学习实验结果，计算统计量，生成对比表格与结论。适用于用户说「分析结果」「对比一下」，或需要解读实验数据时。

description.en: Generates Angular 17+ standalone components, configures advanced routing with lazy loading and guards, implements NgRx state management, applies RxJS patterns, and optimizes bundle performance. Use when building Angular 17+ applications with standalone components or signals, setting up NgRx stores, establishing RxJS reactive patterns, performance tuning, or writing Angular tests for enterprise apps.
description.zh: 生成 Angular 17+ 独立组件，配置带懒加载与路由守卫的高级路由，实现 NgRx 状态管理，应用 RxJS 模式并优化打包体积。适用于用独立组件或信号构建 Angular 17+ 应用、搭建 NgRx store、建立 RxJS 响应式模式、性能调优，或为企业级应用编写 Angular 测试。

description.en: Game-ready animation in Blender including walk/run/idle cycles, combat, mechanical animation, camera animation, constraints, Graph Editor, and NLA workflows via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 游戏级动画：走跑待机循环、战斗、机械动画、相机动画、约束、曲线编辑器与非线性动画工作流。

description.en: Anime and cel-shaded art direction for Blender with hard color breaks, toon shaders, clean silhouettes, and anime proportion language.
description.zh: Blender 动漫与赛璐璐美术指导：硬边色块、卡通着色、干净轮廓与动漫比例语言。

description.en: Use when designing REST or GraphQL APIs, creating OpenAPI specifications, or planning API architecture. Invoke for resource modeling, versioning strategies, pagination patterns, error handling standards.
description.zh: 在设计 REST 或 GraphQL API、编写 OpenAPI 规范或规划 API 架构时使用。可用于资源建模、版本策略、分页模式与错误处理规范。

description.en: Use for authorized security assessment of REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, or SOAP APIs, including discovery, authentication, authorization, rate-limit, and CI/CD testing.
description.zh: 用于对 REST、GraphQL、WebSocket 或 SOAP API 做已授权的安全评估，包括接口发现、认证、授权、限流与 CI/CD 测试。

description.en: Reverse engineer Android APKs from the command line: unpack an APK, decompile the Java, edit smali, repackage, and attach a Frida hook for dynamic analysis, switching to so/native work when the task calls for it. Prefers the jadx, apktool, frida, adb, ida-reverse and radare2 tools already installed on the machine.
description.zh: 在命令行环境下做 Android APK 逆向时使用。适用于 APK 解包、Java 反编译、smali 修改、重打包、Frida 动态 Hook，以及按需切换到 so/native 分析。优先使用本机已安装的 jadx、apktool、frida、adb、ida-reverse、radare2。

description.en: Apocalyptic and dystopian world art direction for Blender including post-apocalyptic, zombie, alien invasion, post-human, dystopian, and utopian contrast sets.
description.zh: Blender 末日与反乌托邦世界美术指导：后启示录、僵尸、外星入侵、后人类、反乌托邦与乌托邦的对比场景。

description.en: Create an ADR documenting a technical decision: context, alternatives considered, consequences.
description.zh: 编写一份记录技术决策的 ADR：背景、考虑过的备选方案、后果。

description.en: Use when designing new high-level system architecture, reviewing existing designs, or making architectural decisions. Invoke to create architecture diagrams, write Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), evaluate technology trade-offs, design component interactions, and plan for scalability. Use for system design, architecture review, microservices structuring, ADR authoring, scalability planning, and infrastructure pattern selection — distinct from code-level design patterns or database-only design tasks.
description.zh: 在设计新的高层系统架构、评审现有设计或做架构决策时使用。可用于绘制架构图、编写架构决策记录（ADR）、评估技术取舍、设计组件交互与规划可扩展性。适用于系统设计、架构评审、微服务拆分、ADR 撰写、扩展性规划与基础设施模式选型——与代码级设计模式或纯数据库设计任务不同。

description.en: Traceability matrix mapping GDD requirements to ADRs. Finds gaps, cross-ADR conflicts, engine compatibility. PASS/CONCERNS/NOT ASSESSED/FAIL.
description.zh: 用追溯矩阵把 GDD 需求映射到 ADR，找出缺口、ADR 之间的冲突与引擎兼容性问题。输出 PASS/CONCERNS/NOT ASSESSED/FAIL。

description.en: Architectural visualization in Blender for interiors/exteriors with real-world scale, camera composition, PBR materials, and still/animation delivery via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 建筑可视化：室内外真实尺度、相机构图、PBR 材质，以及静帧与动画交付。

description.en: Premium Substack / Medium style long-form article layout, ready to publish as a WeChat post or a blog entry.
description.zh: Substack / Medium 风格的高级感长文排版，适合公众号与博客发布。

description.en: Forge a concept into a magazine feature dossier - real problem, failure, turn, insight, name - with six layout moulds, a four-way typeface comparison, and case-file detail.
description.zh: 把一个概念铸成杂志专题档案：真问题→失败→转折→顿悟→命名，配 6 个版式模具、4 组字族对比与探案档案式细节。

description.en: Validates and optimizes Blender assets for polycount, topology, UV efficiency, material count, naming, collections, and game-ready performance. Use before export on all production assets via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 资产校验与优化：面数、拓扑、UV 效率、材质数量、命名、集合与游戏级性能。所有生产资产导出前都应过一遍。

description.en: Use for authorized multi-stage attack-path planning and orchestration when a task spans reconnaissance, initial access, privilege escalation, lateral movement, or impact assessment. Route single-stage tasks directly to their specialist skill.
description.zh: 用于已授权的多阶段攻击路径规划与编排，任务跨侦察、初始访问、提权、横向移动或影响评估时使用。单阶段任务直接路由到对应的专项技能。

description.en: Orchestrates end-to-end autonomous AI research projects using a two-loop architecture. The inner loop runs rapid experiment iterations with clear optimization targets. The outer loop synthesizes results, identifies patterns, and steers research direction. Routes to domain-specific skills for execution, supports continuous agent operation via Claude Code /loop and OpenClaw heartbeat, and produces research presentations and papers. Use when starting a research project, running autonomous experiments, or managing a multi-hypothesis research effort.
description.zh: 用双循环架构编排端到端的自主 AI 研究项目。内循环围绕明确的优化目标快速迭代实验，外循环综合结果、识别规律并调整研究方向。按需路由到各领域专项技能执行，支持通过 Claude Code /loop 与 OpenClaw 心跳持续运行，产出研究报告与论文。适用于启动研究项目、运行自主实验或管理多假设研究工作时。

description.en: Comprehensive backend development guide for Node.js/Express/TypeScript microservices. Use when creating routes, controllers, services, repositories, middleware, or working with Express APIs, Prisma database access, Sentry error tracking, Zod validation, unifiedConfig, dependency injection, or async patterns. Covers layered architecture (routes → controllers → services → repositories), BaseController pattern, error handling, performance monitoring, testing strategies, and migration from legacy patterns.
description.zh: 面向 Node.js/Express/TypeScript 微服务的后端开发指南。适用于编写路由、控制器、服务、仓储、中间件，或处理 Express API、Prisma 数据库访问、Sentry 错误追踪、Zod 校验、unifiedConfig、依赖注入与异步模式。涵盖分层架构（路由 → 控制器 → 服务 → 仓储）、BaseController 模式、错误处理、性能监控、测试策略以及从旧模式迁移。

description.en: Biome and setting art direction for Blender covering underwater, desert, arctic, jungle, underground, and floating-island environments.
description.zh: Blender 生物群系与场景美术指导：水下、沙漠、极地、丛林、地下与浮空岛环境。

description.en: Use when starting any Blender asset task, planning a production pipeline, coordinating multiple disciplines, or matching a reference photo/concept art. Invoke for game-ready assets, hard surface, environment, character, creature, export, or any multi-skill Blender workflow.
description.zh: Blender 总导演：任何资产任务的起点，负责规划生产流程、统筹多学科、对齐参考照片或概念图。适用于游戏级资产、硬表面、环境、角色、生物、导出等任何需要多技能的 Blender 工作流。

description.en: Core Blender modeling specialist for Edit Mode, modifiers, collections, precision modeling, and scene organization. Use for general 3D modeling, blockouts, cleanup, non-destructive workflows, and scene structure in Blender via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 建模核心专长：编辑模式、修改器、集合、精确建模与场景组织。适用于通用三维建模、灰盒、整理、非破坏性工作流与场景结构。

description.en: Magazine-style long-form article layout with a masthead, hero image, figures, a pull quote and a byline.
description.zh: 杂志感长文排版，含 masthead、hero 图、figures、pull quote 与作者署名。

description.en: Body horror art direction for Blender focusing on flesh wrongness, mutation, fusion, and visceral material storytelling.
description.zh: Blender 身体恐怖美术指导：肉体错位、变异、融合与直击感官的材质叙事。

description.en: Converts books and documents (PDF, EPUB, DOCX, HTML, Markdown, plain text, RTF, MOBI/AZW with Calibre) into structured agent skills, extracting frameworks, mental models, principles, techniques, and anti-patterns. Use when the user wants to study a document through GitHub Copilot CLI, Amp, Claude Code, Hermes Agent, OpenCode, or OpenClaw, apply an author's frameworks while working, or build a reusable knowledge base from a file.
description.zh: 把书籍与文档（PDF、EPUB、DOCX、HTML、Markdown、纯文本、RTF，以及经 Calibre 转换的 MOBI/AZW）转成结构化的智能体技能，提取其中的框架、心智模型、原则、技巧与反模式。适用于用户想通过 GitHub Copilot CLI、Amp、Claude Code、Hermes Agent、OpenCode 或 OpenClaw 研读某份文档，在实际工作中套用某位作者的方法论，或从文件搭建可复用的知识库。

description.en: Brutalist and concrete-monument mood direction for Blender architecture and scenes with raw concrete, monumental scale, and austere composition.
description.zh: Blender 野兽派与混凝土纪念碑式氛围：裸露混凝土、纪念性尺度与 austere 构图。

description.en: Cinematic camera work in Blender including framing, lenses, composition, camera animation, and shot language beyond basic rendering setup via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 电影化摄影：构图、镜头选择、机位、相机动画与镜头语言，不止于基础渲染设置。

description.en: Cartoon art direction for Blender with squash-stretch readable shapes, bold colors, and graphic silhouettes for games and animation.
description.zh: Blender 卡通美术指导：拉伸挤压的可读形状、鲜明配色与图形化轮廓，适用于游戏与动画。

description.en: Character archetype art direction for Blender covering fantasy races, horror creatures, roles (knight, assassin, detective), and body types (mecha, android, chibi, etc.).
description.zh: Blender 角色原型美术指导：奇幻种族、恐怖生物、身份角色（骑士、刺客、侦探）与体型（机甲、机器人、Q 版等）。

description.en: AAA character modeling for human anatomy, stylization, facial topology, clothing, hair, and animation-ready meshes. Use for game characters, facial expressions, and production character assets in Blender via MCP.
description.zh: Blender AAA 角色建模：人体解剖、风格化、面部拓扑、服装、头发与可动画网格。适用于游戏角色、面部表情与生产级角色资产。

description.en: Use when cooking or planning meals, troubleshooting recipes, learning culinary techniques
description.zh: 做菜或安排餐食、排查菜谱问题、学习烹饪技法时使用。

description.en: Chibi and SD proportion art direction for Blender characters with oversized heads, simplified anatomy, and cute silhouette rules.
description.zh: Blender Q 版与 SD 比例美术指导：夸张头部、简化解剖与可爱轮廓规则。

description.en: Garment blockout, cloth simulation, pin groups, and bake to shape keys or caches for characters and props in Blender via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 服装打版、布料模拟、钉组，以及烘焙到形态键或缓存，适用角色与道具。

description.en: Collision proxy authoring for games including UCX/UHX naming, convex hulls, capsules, and simple collider meshes in Blender via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 游戏碰撞代理制作：UCX/UHX 命名、凸包、胶囊与简化碰撞网格。

description.en: Comic book and graphic-novel art direction for Blender with ink-line emphasis, halftone cues, and high-contrast framing.
description.zh: Blender 漫画与图像小说美术指导：墨线强调、网点暗示与高对比构图。

description.en: Blender compositor workflows for beauty stacks, render passes, color grade, glare, and delivery outputs via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 合成工作流：beauty 叠加、渲染通道、调色、辉光与交付输出。

description.en: Cosmic, eldritch, and Lovecraftian horror art direction for Blender with non-Euclidean cues, impossible scale, and incomprehensible forms.
description.zh: Blender 宇宙与克苏鲁式恐怖美术指导：非欧几何暗示、不可能尺度与不可理解的形体。

description.en: Cozy, cute, wholesome, relaxing, and peaceful mood direction for Blender assets and scenes.
description.zh: Blender 温馨治愈氛围：可爱、宁静、放松、平和的情绪方向。

description.en: AAA creature modeling for fantasy, aliens, monsters, and organic creature design with believable anatomy and movement. Use for creature blockouts, muscle flow, bone structure, and animation-ready creature assets in Blender via MCP.
description.zh: Blender AAA 生物建模：奇幻、外星、怪物与有机生物设计，可信的解剖与运动。适用于生物灰盒、肌肉走向、骨骼结构与可动画生物资产。

description.en: Dark, grim, gritty, rusty, abandoned, decayed, industrial, lonely, and melancholic mood direction for Blender.
description.zh: Blender 暗黑压抑氛围：阴暗、粗粝、锈蚀、废弃、腐朽、工业、孤寂与忧郁。

description.en: Token architecture, component specifications, and slide generation. Three-layer tokens (primitive→semantic→component), CSS variables, spacing/typography scales, component specs, strategic slide creation. Use for design tokens, systematic design, brand-compliant presentations.
description.zh: 设计令牌体系、组件规范与幻灯片生成。三层令牌（基础→语义→组件）、CSS 变量、间距与字号阶梯、组件规格，以及成套的演示稿生成。适用于设计令牌、体系化设计与品牌规范的演示材料。

description.en: Dreamlike, surreal, mysterious, mystical, hopeful, and chaotic mood direction for Blender scenes.
description.zh: Blender 梦境超现实氛围：梦幻、超现实、神秘、玄奥、充满希望或混乱。

description.en: Dreamcore, weirdcore, and traumacore-inspired art direction for Blender with nostalgic wrongness, liminal nostalgia, and surreal childhood spaces.
description.zh: Blender 梦核、怪核与创伤核美术指导：怀旧的错位、阈限怀旧感与超现实的童年空间。

description.en: AAA environment art for modular kits, buildings, terrain, vegetation, architecture, and scene composition. Use for game-optimized environments, storytelling through space, and modular asset pipelines in Blender via MCP.
description.zh: Blender AAA 环境美术：模块化套件、建筑、地形、植被、建筑结构与场景构图。适用于游戏优化环境、以空间讲故事与模块化资产管线。

description.en: Add Sentry v8 error tracking and performance monitoring to your services. Use this skill when adding error handling, creating new controllers, instrumenting cron jobs, or tracking database performance. ALL ERRORS MUST BE CAPTURED TO SENTRY - no exceptions.
description.zh: 为你的服务接入 Sentry v8 错误追踪与性能监控。适用于添加错误处理、编写新的控制器、给定时任务埋点或追踪数据库性能时。所有错误都必须上报到 Sentry，没有例外。

description.en: Documents manifest locations for an example skill.
description.zh: 说明示例技能的 manifest 放在哪些位置。

description.en: Production export from Blender to FBX, GLTF, OBJ, USD, and Alembic with scale, pivot, rotation, normals, materials, animation, and collision verification via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 生产级导出到 FBX、GLTF、OBJ、USD 与 Alembic，含比例、轴心、旋转、法线、材质、动画与碰撞校验。

description.en: Fantasy world-building art direction for Blender covering medieval, high fantasy, dark fantasy, and urban fantasy asset language.
description.zh: Blender 奇幻世界构建美术指导：中世纪、高魔幻、黑暗奇幻与都市奇幻的资产语言。

description.en: Folk horror art direction for Blender with rural ritual uncanny, pastoral daylight dread, and community-wrongness storytelling.
description.zh: Blender 民俗恐怖美术指导：乡村仪式的诡异感、田园日光下的不安与共同体错位叙事。

description.en: Frontend development guidelines for React/TypeScript applications. Modern patterns including Suspense, lazy loading, useSuspenseQuery, file organization with features directory, MUI v7 styling, TanStack Router, performance optimization, and TypeScript best practices. Use when creating components, pages, features, fetching data, styling, routing, or working with frontend code.
description.zh: 面向 React/TypeScript 应用的前端开发指南。涵盖 Suspense、懒加载、useSuspenseQuery、以 features 目录组织文件、MUI v7 样式、TanStack Router、性能优化与 TypeScript 最佳实践等现代模式。适用于创建组件、页面、功能模块、获取数据、写样式、配置路由或处理前端代码时。

description.en: Frutiger Aero art direction for Blender with glossy skeuomorphism, aqua UI cues, nature-tech optimism, and mid-2000s futurism.
description.zh: Blender Frutiger Aero 美术指导：光泽拟物、水蓝界面暗示、自然科技乐观与千禧年前后的未来感。

description.en: Art direction for action, hack-and-slash, beat 'em up, and fighting-game readable combat spaces and prop language in Blender.
description.zh: Blender 动作、砍杀、格斗与对战游戏的可读战斗空间与道具语言美术指导。

description.en: Art direction for card games, deck builders, party games, idle/incremental, educational, and rhythm game presentational spaces in Blender.
description.zh: Blender 卡牌、构筑卡牌、派对、放置增量、教育与音游的表现层空间美术指导。

description.en: Art direction for metroidvania, roguelike, and roguelite games in Blender with biome gates, room modules, and run-readable props.
description.zh: Blender 银河城、随机肉鸽与 roguelite 美术指导：群系门禁、房间模块与单局可读道具。

description.en: Art direction for visual novel, interactive movie, walking simulator, and story-driven presentation spaces in Blender.
description.zh: Blender 视觉小说、互动电影、步行模拟与叙事驱动游戏的表现空间美术指导。

description.en: Art direction for open world and sandbox games in Blender with biome landmarks, traversable scale, and discovery props.
description.zh: Blender 开放世界与沙盒游戏美术指导：群系地标、可通行的尺度与探索道具。

description.en: Art direction for puzzle and platformer games in Blender with readable interactables, jump volumes, and clear hazard language.
description.zh: Blender 解谜与平台跳跃游戏美术指导：可读的交互物、跳跃体积与清晰的危险语言。

description.en: Art direction for racing and sports games in Blender with track landmarks, stadium kits, and high-speed readability.
description.zh: Blender 竞速与体育游戏美术指导：赛道地标、看台套件与高速下的可读性。

description.en: Art direction for RPG, JRPG, CRPG, ARPG, and MMORPG worlds in Blender including loot rarity reads and region identity.
description.zh: Blender RPG、JRPG、CRPG、ARPG 与 MMORPG 世界美术指导，含战利品稀有度辨识与地域身份。

description.en: Art direction for FPS, TPS, shooter, battle royale, and extraction-shooter maps and props in Blender with sightline and cover language.
description.zh: Blender 第一人称、第三人称、射击、大逃杀与撤离类游戏的地图与道具美术指导，含视线与掩体语言。

description.en: Art direction for soulslike games in Blender with monumental melancholy spaces, fog gates, bonfire landmarks, and lethal readability.
description.zh: Blender 魂系游戏美术指导：纪念性的忧郁空间、雾门、篝火地标与致命可读性。

description.en: Art direction for stealth-game spaces in Blender with shadow volumes, patrol-friendly layouts, and concealment materials.
description.zh: Blender 潜行游戏空间美术指导：阴影体积、便于巡逻的布局与隐蔽材质。

description.en: Art direction for strategy, RTS, turn-based strategy, tower defense, MOBA, city builder, colony sim, and simulation games in Blender.
description.zh: Blender 策略、即时战略、回合制、塔防、MOBA、城市建造、殖民模拟与模拟经营游戏美术指导。

description.en: Art direction for survival and survival-horror gameplay spaces in Blender emphasizing resource props, crafting readability, and tension routes.
description.zh: Blender 生存与生存恐怖玩法空间美术指导：强调资源道具、合成可读性与张力路线。

description.en: Full website GEO+SEO audit with parallel subagent delegation. Orchestrates a comprehensive Generative Engine Optimization audit across AI citability, platform analysis, technical infrastructure, content quality, and schema markup. Produces a composite GEO Score (0-100) with prioritized action plan.
description.zh: 在并行子智能体协作下做整站 GEO+SEO 审计。编排覆盖 AI 可引用性、平台分析、技术基础设施、内容质量与结构化标记的综合生成式引擎优化审计，产出 0-100 的综合 GEO 评分与按优先级排序的行动计划。

description.en: Brand mention and authority scanner for AI visibility. Analyzes brand presence across platforms that AI models rely on for entity recognition and citation decisions. Produces a Brand Authority Score (0-100) with platform-specific recommendations.
description.zh: 面向 AI 可见性的品牌提及与权威度扫描器。分析品牌在 AI 模型进行实体识别与引用决策时所依赖的各平台上的存在情况，产出 0-100 的品牌权威度评分与分平台建议。

description.en: AI citability scoring and optimization. Analyzes web page content to determine how likely AI systems (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini) are to cite or quote passages from the page. Provides a citability score (0-100) with specific rewrite suggestions.
description.zh: AI 可引用性评分与优化。分析网页内容，判断 AI 系统（ChatGPT、Claude、Perplexity、Gemini）有多大可能引用或摘录页面中的段落，给出 0-100 的可引用性评分与具体的改写建议。

description.en: Blender Geometry Nodes for procedural modeling, scatter systems, vegetation, buildings, pipes, cables, and reusable node groups. Use for procedural asset generation and instancing pipelines via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 几何节点：程序化建模、散布系统、植被、建筑、管道、线缆与可复用节点组。适用于程序化资产生成与实例化管线。

description.en: Godot-specific Blender export favoring GLTF/GLB with correct scale, materials, animation clips, and collision shapes via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 面向 Godot 的导出：优先 GLTF/GLB，并保证正确的比例、材质、动画片段与碰撞形状。

description.en: Hair and fur grooming in Blender using curves, particle hair, geometry nodes, and game hair-card workflows. Use for characters, creatures, and real-time hair cards via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 头发与毛发梳理：曲线、粒子毛发、几何节点与游戏用发片工作流。适用于角色、生物与实时发片。

description.en: Anti-AI-slop design skill for greenfield pages, audits, redesigns, and design extraction from URLs or screenshots. Use when the user asks to build a new app or landing page, wants to redesign something, invokes Hallmark by name, or uses audit/redesign/study.
description.zh: 反 AI 味的设计技能，适用于从零做新页面、做审计、改版，以及从 URL 或截图提取设计。适用于用户要求构建新应用或落地页、想做改版、点名 Hallmark，或使用 audit/redesign/study 时。

description.en: Hand-painted texture art direction for Blender with brushwork albedo, soft value transitions, and stylized PBR restraint.
description.zh: Blender 手绘贴图美术指导：笔触反照率、柔和的明度过渡与克制的风格化 PBR。

description.en: AAA hard surface modeling for sci-fi, industrial, military, vehicles, weapons, robotics, and mechanical props. Use for boolean/bevel workflows, panel lines, greebles, chamfers, and manufacturing-accurate surfaces in Blender via MCP.
description.zh: Blender AAA 硬表面建模：科幻、工业、军事、载具、武器、机器人与机械道具。适用于布尔与倒角工作流、分模线、greeble、倒角与符合制造逻辑的表面。

description.en: HD-2D art direction combining pixel characters/sprites with 3D environments, depth of field, and theatrical lighting.
description.zh: HD-2D 美术指导：像素角色与精灵结合三维环境，含景深与剧场式布光。

description.en: Historical and period world art direction for Blender including Western, pirate, samurai/ninja, Viking, ancient Egypt/Greece/Rome, Victorian, modern, and military eras.
description.zh: Blender 历史与年代世界美术指导：西方、海盗、武士与忍者、维京、古埃及、古希腊、古罗马、维多利亚、现代与军事年代。

description.en: Psychological horror art direction for Blender assets inspired by Silent Hill, Resident Evil, Chilla's Art, Fear to Fathom, and Iron Lung. Use for sparse industrial environments, analog aesthetics, and tension-driven lighting.
description.zh: Blender 心理恐怖美术指导，参考寂静岭、生化危机、Chilla 的 Art、Fear to Fathom 与 Iron Lung。适用于稀疏的工业环境、模拟质感与张力驱动的布光。

description.en: Design directly in HTML from inside Claude Code: high-fidelity prototypes, slide decks, animations and visualisations, with expert review built in and MP4 export. Every new design starts with three candidate directions for the user to choose from - naming a style or brand does not skip that step. Not for production web apps or systems that need a backend.
description.zh: 花叔 Design——用 HTML 做高保真原型、幻灯片、动画、可视化与专家评审。任何新设计 100% 先出三个方向初稿给用户选（指定风格或品牌也不豁免），选定后才执行。触发词：做原型、PPT、幻灯片、动画、设计风格、评审、做个 HTML 页面、UI mockup、导出 MP4/GIF、做个好看的。生产级 Web App 或需要后端的系统不适用。

description.en: Edit the filler, repetition and template phrasing out of Chinese articles, comments and documents so the text reads naturally, while preserving the facts, the degree of certainty and the author's own voice. Use to polish existing text; it does not identify authors and does not guarantee that a detector will pass the result.
description.zh: 编辑中文文章、评论与文档中的空话、重复和模板化表达，让文字更自然，同时保留事实、确定程度与作者原本的语气。适用于润色已有文本，不用于判断作者身份，也不保证能通过 AI 检测器。

description.en: One of the AI skills open-sourced by the creator 数字生命卡兹克, in a collection that also includes leader (helps you define a goal), neat-freak, and khazix-writer. Usable from Claude Code, Codex and 40-plus other agents.
description.zh: 数字生命卡兹克开源的 AI 技能合集之一，同系列还有 leader（帮你定义目标）、neat-freak 洁癖与 khazix-writer。可在 Claude Code、Codex 等 40 多个智能体中使用。

description.en: Implements and trains LLMs using Lightning AI's LitGPT with 20+ pretrained architectures (Llama, Gemma, Phi, Qwen, Mistral). Use when need clean model implementations, educational understanding of architectures, or production fine-tuning with LoRA/QLoRA. Single-file implementations, no abstraction layers.
description.zh: 用 Lightning AI 的 LitGPT 实现并训练 LLM，支持 20 多种预训练架构（Llama、Gemma、Phi、Qwen、Mistral）。当你需要干净易懂的模型实现、想从原理上理解这些架构，或用 LoRA/QLoRA 做生产级微调时使用。单文件实现，没有抽象层。

description.en: Indie horror aesthetic pack for Blender covering Silent Hill, Fear to Fathom, Puppet Combo, corporate horror, cabin/forest/hospital horror, and related looks.
description.zh: Blender 独立恐怖美学合集：寂静岭、Fear to Fathom、Puppet Combo、公司恐怖，以及木屋、森林、医院恐怖等风格。

description.en: Isometric and strategy-game art direction for Blender including diorama framing, true-iso camera setup, readable silhouettes, and tile asset rules.
description.zh: Blender 等距视角与策略游戏美术指导：立体模型式取景、真正的等距相机、可读轮廓与地块资产规则。

description.en: A writing skill from the collection open-sourced by 数字生命卡兹克, which also includes leader (helps you define a goal), neat-freak and hv-analysis. Usable from Claude Code, Codex and 40-plus other agents.
description.zh: 数字生命卡兹克开源的 AI 技能合集之一，同系列还有 leader（帮你定义目标）、neat-freak 洁癖与 hv-analysis。可在 Claude Code、Codex 等 40 多个智能体中使用。

description.en: Cinematic and game lighting in Blender including three-point lighting, HDRI, horror lighting, volumetrics, rim lighting, and mood-driven illumination. Use for look development and scene atmosphere via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 电影化与游戏布光：三点布光、HDRI、恐怖布光、体积光、轮廓光与情绪驱动的照明。适用于外观开发与场景氛围。

description.en: Liminal space and Backrooms art direction for Blender with empty transitional architecture, wrong familiarity, and endless repetition.
description.zh: Blender 阈限空间与后室美术指导：空旷的过渡性建筑、错误的熟悉感与无尽重复。

description.en: Dedicated LOD generation, naming, screen-size targets, and validation for game meshes in Blender via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 专用的 LOD 生成、命名、屏幕尺寸目标与校验，面向游戏网格。

description.en: Look development loop for Blender assets combining materials, lighting, camera, and screenshot comparison until shading reads correctly via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 资产的外观开发循环：结合材质、灯光、相机与截图对比，直到着色读起来正确。

description.en: Low-poly art direction for Blender inspired by PS1/PS2, Lethal Company, Mouthwashing, and Fear to Fathom. Use for readable silhouettes, minimal polygons, simple materials, and strong atmosphere.
description.zh: Blender 低多边形美术指导，参考 PS1 与 PS2、Lethal Company、Mouthwashing 与 Fear to Fathom。适用于可读轮廓、极简多边形、简单材质与强烈氛围。

description.en: State-space model with O(n) complexity vs Transformers' O(n²). 5× faster inference, million-token sequences, no KV cache. Selective SSM with hardware-aware design. Mamba-1 (d_state=16) and Mamba-2 (d_state=128, multi-head). Models 130M-2.8B on HuggingFace.
description.zh: 状态空间模型，复杂度为 O(n)，而 Transformer 是 O(n²)。推理快 5 倍，可处理百万级 token 序列，无需 KV 缓存。选择性 SSM 配硬件感知设计，含 Mamba-1（d_state=16）与 Mamba-2（d_state=128，多头）。HuggingFace 上有 130M 到 2.8B 的模型。

description.en: Manga-inspired art direction for Blender emphasizing monochrome value design, speed lines, screentone feel, and manga panel staging.
description.zh: Blender 漫画风美术指导：强调单色明度设计、集中线、网点质感与漫画分镜式调度。

description.en: Mascot and puppet horror art direction for Blender with cheerful brand characters made wrong, felt/foam materials, and uncanny performance.
description.zh: Blender 吉祥物与木偶恐怖美术指导：把欢快的品牌角色做成不对劲的样子，毛毡与泡沫材质以及诡异的表演感。

description.en: Blender PBR and stylized material creation for metal, wood, concrete, fabric, glass, dirt, rust, and procedural shaders. Use for look development, material reuse, and production shading in Blender via MCP.
description.zh: Blender PBR 与风格化材质制作：金属、木材、混凝土、织物、玻璃、泥土、锈迹与程序化着色器。适用于外观开发、材质复用与生产着色。

description.en: Minimalist and abstract-leaning art direction for Blender with reduced forms, limited palettes, and negative space.
description.zh: Blender 极简与抽象倾向的美术指导：削减形体、有限色板与留白。

description.en: Neon, vaporwave, synthwave, and retrofuturistic mood/art direction for Blender with grid horizons, chrome, and dusk palettes.
description.zh: Blender 霓虹、vaporwave、synthwave 与复古未来主义的氛围与美术指导，含网格地平线、镀铬质感与黄昏色板。

description.en: Noir art direction for Blender with high-contrast lighting, wet streets, silhouettes, and monochrome or limited-color grading.
description.zh: Blender 黑色电影美术指导：高对比布光、湿地街道、剪影与单色或限色分级。

description.en: Install, authenticate, troubleshoot, and operate Gemini Notebook through the notebooklm-py CLI or typed async Python API. Use for notebook and source management, grounded chat and research, and artifact generation or download when the user mentions Gemini Notebook, notebooklm-py, the notebooklm CLI, or its Python API. Do not use for the generic Gemini API or unrelated content creation.
description.zh: 通过 notebooklm-py 命令行工具或带类型的异步 Python API 安装、登录、排障并操作 Gemini Notebook。适用于笔记本与资料管理、基于资料源的问答与研究，以及在用户提到 Gemini Notebook、notebooklm-py、notebooklm 命令行或其 Python API 时生成或下载产物。不适用于通用的 Gemini API 或无关的内容创作。

description.en: Painterly art direction spanning watercolor and oil-painting looks for Blender using soft edges, pigment texture, and illustrative lighting.
description.zh: Blender 绘画感美术指导，横跨水彩与油画风格：柔和边缘、颜料质感与插画式布光。

description.en: Rigid body, soft body, and destruction setups in Blender including constraints, cell fracture debris, and baked caches via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 刚体、柔体与破坏设置：约束、单元破碎碎片与烘焙缓存。

description.en: Pixel-art and texel-constrained art direction for Blender assets destined for pixel rendering, low-res textures, or HD-2D-adjacent pixel reads.
description.zh: Blender 像素画与受像素格约束的美术指导，面向像素渲染、低分辨率贴图或 HD-2D 邻接的像素观感。

description.en: Procedural asset creation for rocks, buildings, vegetation, roads, terrain, pipes, cables, and sci-fi panels using Geometry Nodes and modifier-based workflows in Blender via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 程序化资产制作：岩石、建筑、植被、道路、地形、管道、线缆与科幻面板，使用几何节点与基于修改器的工作流。

description.en: Generates optimized prompts for AI tools. Activates only when the user explicitly asks to write, fix, improve, or adapt a prompt for a specific AI tool (LLM, Cursor, Midjourney, image AI, video AI, coding agents, etc.). Does not activate for general conversation, coding tasks, document writing, or other non-prompt-engineering work.
description.zh: 为 AI 工具生成优化后的提示词。仅在用户明确要求为某个具体 AI 工具（LLM、Cursor、Midjourney、图像 AI、视频 AI、编码智能体等）撰写、修正、改进或改写提示词时启用。日常对话、编码任务、文档写作或其他与提示词工程无关的工作不会触发。

description.en: Everyday and hero prop modeling for furniture, tools, household objects, kitbash parts, and readable game props. Use when hard-surface is too sci-fi/mechanical and the asset is a grounded prop.
description.zh: Blender 日常与主角道具建模：家具、工具、家居物件、套件拼装部件与可读的游戏道具。适用于硬表面过于科幻或机械、而资产是写实日常物件时。

description.en: PS1/PSX-era horror art direction combining low-poly affine textures, limited color depth, fog, and psychological horror staging for Blender assets.
description.zh: Blender PS1 与 PSX 时代恐怖美术指导：低多边形仿射贴图、有限色彩深度、雾气与心理恐怖调度。

description.en: Production QA gate for Blender assets using viewport screenshots, validation checklists, naming audits, and ship/no-ship verdicts via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 资产生产质检关卡：视口截图、校验清单、命名审计与放行或不放行的判定。

description.en: Photorealistic AAA art direction for Blender including photogrammetry cleanup, real-world scale, high-poly workflows, PBR accuracy, and scan optimization. Use for cinematic and AAA game realism.
description.zh: Blender 照片级 AAA 美术指导：摄影测量清理、真实尺度、高模工作流、PBR 精度与扫描优化。适用于电影级与 AAA 游戏的真实感。

description.en: Blender rendering with Cycles and Eevee including sampling, denoising, camera setup, render passes, color management, and render optimization. Use for final output and look validation via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 使用 Cycles 与 Eevee 渲染：采样、降噪、相机设置、渲染通道、色彩管理与渲染优化。适用于最终输出与外观校验。

description.en: Production retopology for animation-ready, low-poly, quad-dominant meshes with proper edge loops and efficient polygon flow. Use after sculpting or high-poly modeling before rigging and UV work in Blender via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 生产级重拓扑：可动画、低多边形、以四边面为主的网格，正确的边循环与高效的多边形走向。适用于雕刻或高模之后、绑定与 UV 之前。

description.en: Retro 16-bit art direction for Blender-assisted SNES/Genesis-era color richness, dither cues, and sprite-like clarity.
description.zh: Blender 复古 16 位美术指导：SNES 与世嘉主机时代的色彩丰富度、抖动暗示与精灵般的清晰度。

description.en: Retro 8-bit art direction for Blender-assisted pixel/low-res aesthetics inspired by NES-era constraints.
description.zh: Blender 复古 8 位美术指导：受 NES 时代约束启发的像素与低分辨率观感。

description.en: Production rigging in Blender with armatures, IK/FK, constraints, weight painting, mechanical rigs, facial rigs, and drivers. Use before animation on deforming assets via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 生产级绑定：骨架、正向反向运动学、约束、权重绘制、机械绑定、面部绑定与驱动器。适用于变形资产动画之前。

description.en: Large scene layout in Blender with collections, linking, overrides, streaming-friendly organization, and set assembly via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 大场景布局：集合、链接、覆盖、流式友好的组织方式与场景组装。

description.en: Sci-fi and punk world art direction for Blender including hard sci-fi, space, cyberpunk, steampunk, dieselpunk, atompunk, solarpunk, biopunk, and clockpunk.
description.zh: Blender 科幻与朋克世界美术指导：硬科幻、太空、赛博朋克、蒸汽朋克、柴油朋克、原子朋克、太阳朋克、生物朋克与时钟朋克。

description.en: Blender sculpting for organic and hard surface detail using Dyntopo, multiresolution, brushes, alpha workflow, wrinkles, and damage. Use when high-frequency surface detail is needed before retopology in Blender via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 雕刻：用 Dyntopo、多分辨率、笔刷、alpha 工作流、褶皱与损伤处理有机与硬表面细节。适用于重拓扑之前需要高频表面细节时。

description.en: Set dressing and environmental storytelling placement for interiors and exteriors using prop density, narrative clusters, and readability rules via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 场景陈设与环境叙事摆放：通过道具密度、叙事聚类与可读性规则布置室内外。

description.en: Automatically detect source types and build AI skills using Skill Seekers. Use when the user wants to create skills from documentation, repos, PDFs, videos, or other knowledge sources.
description.zh: 用 Skill Seekers 自动识别源类型并构建 AI 技能。适用于用户想从文档、仓库、PDF、视频或其他知识来源创建技能时。

description.en: Review AI agent skills before installation using NVIDIA SkillSpector and source-aware semantic review. Use when asked whether a skill or downloaded skill folder is safe, trustworthy, installable, over-permissioned, or malicious.
description.zh: 安装前用 NVIDIA SkillSpector 加上面向源码的语义审查来检查 AI 智能体技能。适用于被问及某个技能或下载来的技能目录是否安全、可信、可安装、权限过大或带有恶意时。

description.en: Stop-motion and craft aesthetics for Blender including claymation, paper craft, and handmade physical-material cues.
description.zh: Blender 定格动画与手工质感美学：黏土定格、纸艺与手工材质的暗示。

description.en: Stylized art direction for Blender with shape language, exaggeration, color harmony, NPR rendering, and hand-painted asset workflows. Use for non-photorealistic game and animation projects.
description.zh: Blender 风格化美术指导：形状语言、夸张、色彩和谐、非真实感渲染与手绘资产工作流。适用于非照片级项目。

description.en: Production texture workflow for atlases, baking AO/curvature/normal/roughness maps, decals, and texture memory optimization. Use for game-ready texture pipelines in Blender via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 生产级贴图工作流：图集、烘焙环境光遮蔽与曲率法线粗糙度贴图、贴花贴图与贴图内存优化。

description.en: Create beautiful, accessible user interfaces with shadcn/ui components (built on Radix UI + Tailwind), Tailwind CSS utility-first styling, and canvas-based visual designs. Use when building user interfaces, implementing design systems, creating responsive layouts, adding accessible components (dialogs, dropdowns, forms, tables), customizing themes and colors, implementing dark mode, generating visual designs and posters, or establishing consistent styling patterns across applications.
description.zh: 用 shadcn/ui（基于 Radix UI + Tailwind）、Tailwind 工具类与画布式视觉设计，做出好看且无障碍的界面。构建设计体系、响应式布局、对话框／下拉／表单／表格等无障碍组件，定制主题与配色，实现深色模式，生成视觉稿与海报，或在多个应用之间保持统一风格时使用。

description.en: UI/UX design intelligence for web, mobile, and desktop. This skill should be used when designing, building, reviewing, or fixing interfaces, including pages, components, design systems, accessibility, interaction, responsive layout, typography, color, charts, and stack-specific UI implementation. Searchable local data: 79 searchable styles (50 active), 192 product palettes and reasoning profiles, 74 font pairings, 119 UX guidelines, 105 icons, 17 GSAP presets, 25 chart types, and 22 stacks.
description.zh: 面向 Web、移动端和桌面的 UI/UX 设计能力。在设计、构建、评审或修复界面时使用，涵盖页面、组件、设计体系、无障碍、交互、响应式布局、排版、配色、图表以及具体技术栈的界面实现。内置可检索的本地数据：79 种可检索风格（50 种启用）、192 套产品配色与推理配置、74 组字体搭配、119 条 UX 准则、105 个图标、17 套 GSAP 预设、25 种图表类型和 22 个技术栈。

description.en: Unity-specific Blender export for scale, axis, materials, humanoid/generic rigs, LODs, and collision import via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 面向 Unity 的导出：比例、轴向、材质、人形与通用绑定、LOD 与碰撞导入。

description.en: Unreal Engine-specific Blender export for FBX scale, LODs, UCX collision, sockets, materials, and skeletal mesh workflows via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 面向虚幻引擎的导出：FBX 比例、LOD、UCX 碰撞、插槽、材质与骨骼网格工作流。

description.en: Production UV unwrapping for seam placement, UV packing, texel density, UDIM, lightmap UVs, and modular UV layouts. Use when preparing meshes for texturing and engine export in Blender via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 生产级 UV 展开：接缝位置、UV 排布、像素密度、UDIM、lightmap UV 与模块化 UV 布局。适用于为贴图与引擎导出准备网格。

description.en: Vector-clean art direction for Blender with flat fills, sharp silhouettes, and UI-like graphic clarity.
description.zh: Blender 矢量风格美术指导：平涂、锐利轮廓与界面式的图形清晰度。

description.en: Vegetation and foliage authoring for Blender including trees, plants, grass cards, canopy LODs, and game-friendly leaf atlases via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 植被与枝叶制作：树木、植物、草片、树冠 LOD 与适合游戏的叶片图集。

description.en: Dedicated vehicle modeling for cars, trucks, aircraft, ships, boats, mechs, and transit assets with proportion, panel flow, and game LOD awareness in Blender via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 载具建模：汽车、卡车、飞机、舰船、小艇、机甲与交通工具资产，兼顾比例、面板走向与游戏 LOD 意识。

description.en: Cinematic and game VFX in Blender including smoke, fire, particles, trails, and Geometry Nodes FX setups via MCP.
description.zh: Blender 电影级与游戏特效：烟雾、火焰、粒子、拖尾与几何节点特效设置。

description.en: Visual era art direction for Blender covering PS1–PS5 stylistic cues, retro arcade, DOS, CRT, VHS, and film-grain presentation.
description.zh: Blender 各世代主机视觉美术指导：PS1 到 PS5 的风格线索、复古街机、DOS、CRT、VHS 与胶片颗粒表现。

description.en: Voxel and Minecraft-adjacent art direction for Blender with block grid modeling, limited palettes, and chunk-friendly assets.
description.zh: Blender 体素与 Minecraft 邻接风格美术指导：方块网格建模、有限色板与对区块友好的资产。
